item.title: Ex-Villa striker Duran joins seventh club aged 22
item.description:
Global Talent on the Move: Jhon Duran’s Seventh Club in Just Seven Years

At the age of 22, Jhon Duran has already accumulated an astonishing seven clubs in his fledgling career, with the latest addition being Portuguese giants Benfica on a season-long loan from Saudi Arabian side Al-Nassr. The Colombian striker has been making waves in the football world with his lightning-fast transfers, and this latest move has sparked both excitement and curiosity among fans and pundits alike.
